data.name: HelpBody
data.value:
Choose a source from the Usage source menu.
WebView2 Uses a private in-app browser profile. 1. Select WebView2. 2. Open "Open login / usage page" and sign in. 3. Close the window. Usage refreshes automatically. Proxy settings apply only to this mode. Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
Codex CLI Uses the account signed in through the locally installed Codex CLI. 1. Install Codex CLI. 2. Run "codex login" once if needed. 3. Select Codex CLI. Choose "Refresh now" to retry if needed. WebView2 login and proxy settings are not used.
Both modes only read usage information. This app never uses a reset in your account.
Security and Privacy
This app does not send your login or account information to the developer or any third-party service.
Passwords, cookies, and access tokens are not read or stored by the app. WebView2 login data stays in a local app-specific browser profile. Codex CLI credentials remain managed by Codex CLI.
The account email is used only to identify the active account. It is kept in memory, never saved, and appears only in masked form in logs.
The app has no telemetry or cloud backend. Usage information is read-only, and the app never uses a reset in your account.
